lines: Mom, Mara, listen to me, I am going to make sure we get through this safely.
Daniel, we are all frightened, but we need to stay calm and stay here together.
You always say that, Daniel, but you took the food and now there is nothing left for us.
Trust me, I am going to make sure we get through this safely together.
You always say that, Daniel, but you're the one who took the food and left us with nothing!
Children, stop fighting now, we only have each other and we must stay calm.
Mara, stop accusing me when I am trying to keep us all alive.
You keep telling us to trust you, but you took the food and left us with nothing.
Listen to me, I am going to make sure we get through this together and nobody is going to starve.
Grand promises do not fill an empty shelf, Daniel.
Let's not fight among ourselves; we only have each other to rely on right now.
You took it and you are lying to all of us.
Leo, you have no right to question my authority when I am doing everything I can to keep us all alive.
Your authority means nothing if your reckless trips only bring back empty hands.
You think big speeches fix anything, but you brought back nothing while we starve.
Please, stop arguing, we need to stay calm and protect each other.
Leo, you have no right to question my authority when I am doing everything I can to keep us alive.
Your grand speeches do not change the fact that we have nothing left because of you, Daniel.
Listen to me, I went out last night and there is nothing out there. We will figure this out together right here.
You went out into the night and came back with nothing, Daniel. Why did you even go?
We are staying right here together, and we will be safe.
You went out into the dark and came back with nothing, Daniel, just as I told you would happen.
Listen to me, we are going to get through this together and I won't let anything happen to you.
We are safe here together, and we will find a way through this without leaving.
You went out into the street last night and came back with nothing at all!
You went out there last night and came back with nothing, Daniel. Putting yourself at risk solved nothing.
We are still alive, and I will figure something out for us. Just stay calm.
You went out into the night and came back with nothing, Daniel. Why did you even go?
You snuck out last night like I warned you not to, Daniel, and now we are worse off than before.
Please, let us not fight among ourselves when we are all so tired.
We are going to be fine, just trust me.
You snuck out last night and came back with nothing, Daniel! Why did you even go?
Let us not fight each other now. We will get through this day together.
Daniel, you snuck out last night against our warning and brought back nothing. You put us all at risk for nothing.
Leo, I am sorry I went out there, but I had to see if there was anything left for us.
You went out into the dark and came back with nothing, Daniel, risking everything for no reason.
I'm sorry, Leo, I just had to check if there was anything left for us out there.
You went out there alone against what we agreed, Daniel, and now there is still nothing.
I know what I'm doing, Leo, I'll figure it out for us.
Daniel, getting up in the dark and sneaking out was reckless, and it put all of us at risk.
I'm sorry, Leo, I just had to check. We'll figure something else out.
Daniel, you didn't bring anything back last night, and we are starving. Going out there alone accomplished nothing except putting us all at risk.
I know what I'm doing, Leo, just trust me.
Daniel, you went out into the night and came back with nothing. Why did you even go?
We are going to figure this out together, just stay calm.
You can spare us the lectures after sneaking out last night.
You went out into the street last night and came back with nothing, Daniel. Why would you do that?
Daniel, you came back safe, and that is what matters most to us.
Leo, you have no right lecturing me after I risked my life out there for all of us.
Risking your life for us by sneaking out isn't an excuse, Daniel, it's just reckless.
Daniel, you went out to help us, we are all just worried about you.
Daniel, you snuck out last night and came back with nothing, how could you do that?
Leo, stop judging me for trying to find a way out of this.
Daniel, trying to find a way out doesn't excuse sneaking out and making things worse.
Leo, you act like you know better, but you just sit here while I take the risks for all of us.
Daniel, taking risks that put everyone in danger isn't helping us survive.
Leo, stop lecturing me about risks when you don't understand what it takes to keep this family alive.
Leo, stop judging me when I am the only one actually trying to fix this mess.
Trying to fix it doesn't mean making things worse for everyone else, Daniel.
